description: A performance request gets a spec that keeps its point: the count comes back as a number, without sending or serializing the full list.

issue.title: Speed up todo loading
issue.body: The client fetches every todo just to show how many there are. Add a `count` query parameter to GET /api/todos that returns only the total number of todos as `{ "count": N }` instead of the full list. It should not serialize the whole list to compute the count.
